title: {Gd44Ni22}: a gigantic 3d–4f wheel-like nanoscale cluster with a large magnetocaloric effect

synthesis.procedure: Dissolve H3dmpa, iminodiacetic acid, gadolinium nitrate hexahydrate and nickel nitrate hydrate in 10 mL water. Stir for 24 h, then add freshly prepared 3.0 M aqueous NaOH dropwise until incipient persistent precipitation (pH 6). Filter, seal the mixture in a 25 mL Teflon-lined stainless-steel vessel, and heat at 140 °C for 4 days. Cool to room temperature at 5 °C/h. Evaporate the filtrate in a beaker under ambient conditions; light-green block crystals form after about 20 days. The SI synthesis paragraph calls the nickel salt a tetrahydrate, whereas its chemicals list and the main article call it a hexahydrate; the reported mass and mmol are retained without resolving that discrepancy.

reagents.name: sodium hydroxide solution
reagents.amount: 3.0 M aqueous solution, added dropwise to pH 6; volume not reported

synthesis.time: 24 h stirring; 4 days heating; approximately 20 days evaporation/crystallization
synthesis.vessel_or_method: 25 mL Teflon-lined stainless-steel vessel; hydrothermal heating
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Filtered before heating; subsequent evaporation of the filtrate in a beaker under ambient conditions yielded light-green block crystals.

properties.summary: The cluster shows weak antiferromagnetic interactions and a large magnetocaloric effect.

measurements.name: magnetization
measurements.conditions: 2 K; applied field 7 T; not saturated

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: A discrete giant wheel comprises a {Gd42Ni22} wheel-shaped component and two additional Gd3+ ions. The wheel component is described in terms of two Gd7 type-I units, two Gd10Ni7 type-II units and four Gd2Ni2 type-III units linked by bridging hydroxo, oxo and carbonate groups.
